prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: high-resolution hand-painted, seamlessly repeating game sky texture. Input image 1 is the ONLY edit target and exact composition authority, an original low-resolution Might and Magic sky tile. Repaint THIS SAME IMAGE at 2048 x 2048 pixels, square, highest available native resolution (at least 1024 x 1024). This is a faithful restoration, not a reinterpretation. Every existing cloud must keep its EXACT position, outline, size, orientation, and direction of flow. Preserve all the large and small cloud formations, negative spaces, colour distribution, palette, original lighting direction and mood. Change only resolution and surface quality: replace 8-bit dithering, banding and pixel blocks with smooth hand-painted gradients and fine soft wisps, billows and subtle internal cloud shading. Preserve the modest painterly style of the original, no photographic look, no extra contrast or brightness. The image fills the entire canvas edge to edge, no framing or crop. The original repeats on BOTH axes: left edge clouds must continue naturally into the right edge, and top edge clouds into bottom. Maintain the exact original edge-crossing clouds and periodic colour/shape continuity with no seam when tiled 2 x 2. Generate just ONE texture, not a collage, contact sheet or tiled preview. Absolutely no sun, moon, stars, rays, lens flare, horizon, ground, mountains, birds, buildings, text, logos, frames, vignettes, borders, margins or watermarks.
Sky-specific constraints: open blue sky with soft mauve-grey clouds. Paint EVERY open gap between clouds as one perfectly flat solid even sRGB colour #3d5994 (RGB 61,89,148), identical at every clear-sky pixel everywhere on the canvas. No gradient, noise, haze, paper/canvas grain or texture whatsoever in that blue background. All fine painterly detail is confined to the existing clouds, whose soft edges blend naturally against this single flat blue. Keep the source's cloud coverage and all blue openings exactly. Original palette, brightest first: #9b8e9e, #797990, #5c678b, #495f91, #3d5994. Keep the muted lavender-grey highlights and cool blue-grey shadows; do not turn clouds bright white or make the blue vivid.
reason: Rejected: 12 sampled clear-sky gaps vary between RGB (64,94,151) and (66,95,152), rather than the required flat RGB (61,89,148). Composition, square size and visual tiling otherwise passed.

checks.cloud_layout_visual_review: Pass: original cloud groups and openings retained, with painterly fine detail.
checks.tiling_visual_review: Pass: inspected a 2 x 2 repeat; no conspicuous seam or cut-off cloud.
